ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: I grow tomatoes and onions in my garden.
ex.zh: 我在花園種了番茄和洋蔥。

ex.en: My aunt grows tomatoes in her garden.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在她的花園裡種番茄。

tomato.en: a soft round red fruit eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable

ex.en: The policeman didn't tow your car away.
ex.zh: 警察沒有把你的車拖走。

ex.en: My car broke down and had to be towed.
ex.zh: 我的車拋錨了，只好叫拖吊。

ex.en: Cars parked here will be towed.
ex.zh: 停在這裡的車會被拖吊。

tow.en: to pull a vehicle along by connecting it to another vehicle

ex.en: We called a tow truck after the accident.
ex.zh: 車禍後我們叫了拖吊車。

ex.en: The tow truck arrived in 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 拖吊車三十分鐘後就到了。

tow.en: a truck used to pull broken or wrongly parked vehicles away

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車的最大載重是五噸。

ex.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
ex.zh: 這輛貨車的載重超過三噸。

ex.en: This grizzly bear weighs half a ton.
ex.zh: 這隻灰熊重達半噸。

ton.en: a unit of weight equal to about 1,000 kilograms or 2,000 pounds

ton.zh: tons of / a ton of：大量的、很多

ex.en: He left me with tons of hard work to do.
ex.zh: 他丟給我一大堆辛苦的工作。

ex.en: I have tons of emails to answer.
ex.zh: 我有一大堆電子郵件要回。

ton.en: a very large amount or number

ex.en: We must pay a toll to drive on this road.
ex.zh: 在這條路上開車必須付通行費。

ex.en: Is there a toll on this highway?
ex.zh: 這條高速公路要收通行費嗎？

toll.en: money you pay to use a road or bridge

toll.zh: take a toll on：對…造成損害

ex.en: Stress can take a toll on your health.
ex.zh: 壓力會傷害你的健康。

ex.en: Long working hours took a toll on him.
ex.zh: 長時間工作把他累壞了。

toll.en: to cause damage or harm over a period of time

ex.en: The printer is running out of toner.
ex.zh: 印表機的碳粉快用完了。

ex.en: Can you order more toner for the copier?
ex.zh: 你可以幫影印機多訂一些碳粉嗎？

toner.en: a powder used by printers and copiers to make words and pictures on paper

ex.en: Apply toner after washing your face.
ex.zh: 洗完臉後擦化妝水。

ex.en: This toner is good for oily skin.
ex.zh: 這款化妝水適合油性肌膚。

toner.en: a liquid put on the skin of the face to clean it and make it feel fresh

toiletry.zh: 盥洗用品（常用複數 toiletries）

ex.en: Don't forget to pack your toiletries.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶盥洗用品。

ex.en: The hotel provides free toiletries in every room.
ex.zh: 飯店每間房都提供免費的盥洗用品。

toiletry.en: a product such as soap or shampoo that you use to wash and care for your body

ex.en: We'd like to order 18 tonnes of olive oil.
ex.zh: 我們想訂購 18 公噸的橄欖油。

ex.en: The truck can carry ten tonnes of goods.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車可以載十公噸的貨。

tonne.en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was torture.
ex.zh: 等考試結果真是一種折磨。

ex.en: Sitting in traffic for two hours is pure torture.
ex.zh: 塞車塞了兩個小時簡直是酷刑。

torture.en: great pain or suffering, or the act of hurting someone on purpose

ex.en: Stop torturing yourself about the mistake.
ex.zh: 別再為那個錯誤折磨自己了。

ex.en: He was tortured by guilt for years.
ex.zh: 他多年來飽受罪惡感折磨。

torture.en: to cause someone great pain or worry

ex.en: The room smelled of tobacco.
ex.zh: 房間裡有菸味。

ex.en: Today is World No Tobacco Day.
ex.zh: 今天是世界無菸日。

ex.en: The government raised taxes on tobacco.
ex.zh: 政府調高了菸品稅。

tobacco.en: the dried leaves of a plant that people smoke in cigarettes or pipes

ex.en: Negligence is a common type of tort.
ex.zh: 過失是常見的侵權行為類型。

ex.en: She studied tort law at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學讀過侵權法。

tort.en: a wrong act that harms another person and for which the law allows a claim for money

ex.en: I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了這個噪音了。

ex.en: I cannot tolerate his actions.
ex.zh: 我無法容忍他的行為。

ex.en: The company does not tolerate rudeness toward customers.
ex.zh: 公司不容許對客人無禮。

tolerate.en: to accept something unpleasant without becoming angry

ex.en: I walk to the office every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上走路去辦公室。

ex.en: Is this the train to Kaohsiung?
ex.zh: 這是開往高雄的火車嗎？

to.en: used to show the place or direction where someone or something goes

ex.en: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
ex.zh: 你不應該那樣跟父母頂嘴。

ex.en: Please give the report to Amy.
ex.zh: 請把報告交給艾咪。

to.en: used to show who or what receives an action

ex.en: The store is open from 9 to 6.
ex.zh: 這家店從九點營業到六點。

ex.en: Prices range from $10 to $50.
ex.zh: 價格從十元到五十元不等。

to.en: used to show the end point of a period of time or a range

to.zh: to＋原形動詞（不定詞）：去做…；為了…

ex.en: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.
ex.zh: 我會盡量不打擾你唸書。

ex.en: You can't expect me to always think of everything!
ex.zh: 你不能指望我每件事都想得到！

to.en: used before a verb to show an action, a purpose or an intention

ex.en: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你年紀還太小，不能考駕照。

ex.en: You are too ready to speak ill of others.
ex.zh: 你太愛說別人壞話了。

ex.en: This coffee is too hot.
ex.zh: 這杯咖啡太燙了。

too.en: more than is needed or wanted

ex.en: I like coffee, too.
ex.zh: 我也喜歡咖啡。

ex.en: Amy is coming to the party, too.
ex.zh: 艾咪也會來派對。

ex.en: Why are there no taxis at the station today?
ex.zh: 為什麼今天車站沒有計程車？

ex.en: I have three meetings today.
ex.zh: 我今天有三個會議。

ex.en: Pretty good. Did you go to today's history seminar?
ex.zh: 還不錯。你去參加今天的歷史研討會了嗎？

ex.en: Today is my first day at the new job.
ex.zh: 今天是我新工作的第一天。

ex.en: English is taught almost all over the world today.
ex.zh: 如今全世界幾乎都在教英語。

ex.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
ex.zh: 如今，我們的人造衛星正環繞著地球運行。

ex.en: English is a very important language in today's world.
ex.zh: 英語在當今世界是非常重要的語言。

ex.en: Today's young people spend a lot of time online.
ex.zh: 現今的年輕人花很多時間上網。

ex.en: I wish that we could spend more time together.
ex.zh: 我希望我們能有更多時間在一起。

ex.en: Tom and Mary always work together as a team.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是組成團隊一起工作。

ex.en: I thought we were going to do this together.
ex.zh: 我以為我們要一起做這件事。

together.en: with each other, or at the same time and place

ex.en: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
ex.zh: 他們約好七點在這裡碰面。

ex.en: Let's get together for dinner next week.
ex.zh: 我們下週一起吃個晚餐吧。

together.en: to meet with other people for a social purpose

ex.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
ex.zh: 那個小鎮離海岸兩英里。

ex.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
ex.zh: 海嘯席捲稻田，淹沒了城鎮。

ex.en: They regarded him as the best doctor in town.
ex.zh: 大家認為他是鎮上最好的醫生。

town.en: a place with many houses, shops and other buildings, larger than a village

town.zh: 市區；（out of town）出城、不在本地

ex.en: My manager is out of town this week.
ex.zh: 我的主管這週出差不在。

ex.en: Let's go into town for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們去市區吃晚餐吧。

town.en: the main shopping or business area of a place, or the place where you live

ex.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們終於抵達山頂。

ex.en: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.
ex.zh: 山頂被雪覆蓋。

ex.en: The cat is sitting on top of the table.
ex.zh: 貓坐在桌子上面。

ex.en: She is one of our top salespeople.
ex.zh: 她是我們頂尖的業務之一。

ex.en: The hotel bar is on the top floor.
ex.zh: 飯店酒吧在頂樓。

top.en: highest in position, rank or quality

ex.en: Sales topped one million dollars.
ex.zh: 銷售額突破一百萬美元。

ex.en: The song topped the charts for weeks.
ex.zh: 這首歌連續好幾週登上排行榜冠軍。

top.en: to be more than a certain amount, or to be in first place

ex.en: On top of that, the train was late.
ex.zh: 更糟的是，火車還誤點了。

ex.en: On top of his salary, he gets a bonus.
ex.zh: 除了薪水之外，他還有獎金。

ex.en: Hundreds of buffaloes moved toward the lake.
ex.zh: 數百頭水牛朝湖邊移動。

ex.en: She keeps on rolling her eyes towards our direction.
ex.zh: 她一直朝我們這邊翻白眼。

toward.en: in the direction of someone or something

ex.en: He often takes a defiant attitude toward us.
ex.zh: 他常對我們採取反抗的態度。

ex.en: What is your attitude toward working overtime?
ex.zh: 你對加班的看法是什麼？

toward.en: used to show how someone feels about or acts with someone or something

ex.en: Can Edinburgh show us the way towards healthier cities?
ex.zh: 愛丁堡能為我們指出邁向更健康城市的方法嗎？

ex.en: The money will go toward a new office.
ex.zh: 這筆錢將用於新辦公室。

toward.en: used to show the aim that an action or payment helps to reach

total.zh: 總數、總計（in total / a total of）

ex.en: There are about ten to twenty students in total.
ex.zh: 總共大約有十到二十個學生。

ex.en: This trip of mine would need twelve days in total.
ex.zh: 我這趟旅行總共需要十二天。

ex.en: It caused a total of 60 million deaths.
ex.zh: 總共造成六千萬人死亡。

total.en: the whole number or amount when everything is added together

ex.en: What is the total amount of money you spent?
ex.zh: 你總共花了多少錢？

ex.en: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.
ex.zh: 這項計畫的總支出達一億日圓。

ex.en: Did you see yesterday's total lunar eclipse?
ex.zh: 你看到昨天的月全食了嗎？

ex.en: The party was a total disaster.
ex.zh: 那場派對徹底搞砸了。

ex.en: Sales totaled two million dollars last year.
ex.zh: 去年銷售額總計兩百萬美元。

ex.en: The bill totals 85 dollars.
ex.zh: 帳單總共八十五美元。

total.en: to reach a certain amount when everything is added together

ex.en: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
ex.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去打棒球。

ex.en: What will you be doing at this time tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你明天這個時候會在做什麼？

ex.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
ex.zh: 要在明天之前完成報告幾乎不可能。

ex.en: My son is busy studying for the examinations tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我兒子正忙著準備明天的考試。

tomorrow.en: the day after today, or the time in the future

ex.en: Let go of my arm! I can't stand people touching me.
ex.zh: 放開我的手臂！我受不了別人碰我。

ex.en: The earthworm wriggled when I touched it.
ex.zh: 我碰蚯蚓時，牠扭動了起來。

ex.en: Please don't touch the paintings.
ex.zh: 請勿觸摸畫作。

touch.en: to put your hand or another part of your body on something

ex.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
ex.zh: 所有客人都被她的熱情款待感動了。

ex.en: I was touched by his kind words.
ex.zh: 他親切的話讓我很感動。

touch.en: to make someone feel pity, love or gratitude

touch.zh: get / keep in touch：聯絡、保持聯絡

ex.en: There's no way to get in touch with him.
ex.zh: 沒有辦法聯絡上他。

ex.en: I hope we'll be able to keep in touch.
ex.zh: 希望我們能保持聯絡。

touch.en: to contact someone or stay in contact with them

ex.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.
ex.zh: 做這件事你會需要特殊的工具。

ex.en: Check the tools and see if anything is missing.
ex.zh: 檢查一下工具，看有沒有少了什麼。

ex.en: These tools are used for building a house.
ex.zh: 這些工具是用來蓋房子的。

tool.en: something that you hold in your hand to do a particular job

ex.en: A computer is a type of modern tool.
ex.zh: 電腦是一種現代工具。

ex.en: Social media is a powerful marketing tool.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是強大的行銷工具。

tool.en: something that helps you to do a job or reach a goal

ex.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.
ex.zh: 我們討論了各式各樣的話題。

ex.en: I chose this topic because I think it's interesting.
ex.zh: 我選這個主題是因為我覺得它很有趣。

ex.en: After ten minutes, they passed on to a new topic.
ex.zh: 十分鐘後，他們換了個新話題。

topic.en: a subject that you write about, study or talk about

ex.en: What you've said is totally accurate.
ex.zh: 你說的完全正確。

ex.en: Who said that? It's totally wrong!
ex.zh: 那是誰說的？完全是錯的！

ex.en: Life without love is just totally pointless.
ex.zh: 沒有愛的人生毫無意義。

ex.en: Do you want to go to a movie tonight?
ex.zh: 你今晚想去看電影嗎？

ex.en: Tonight we are planning to go to the concert.
ex.zh: 今晚我們打算去聽音樂會。

ex.en: I heard the weather forecast said it'll rain tonight.
ex.zh: 我聽氣象預報說今晚會下雨。

tonight.en: during the evening or night of today

ex.en: Attending high school in Korea is tough.
ex.zh: 在韓國讀高中很辛苦。

ex.en: Tom certainly has a tough job.
ex.zh: 湯姆的工作確實很不容易。

ex.en: It was a tough decision to make.
ex.zh: 這是個很難做的決定。

tough.en: hard to do or to live through

ex.en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
ex.zh: 他很堅強，不會輕易灰心。

ex.en: She's a tough competitor, isn't she?
ex.zh: 她是個難纏的對手，對吧？

tough.en: strong in body or mind and able to deal with hard situations

ex.en: The government is getting tough on drunk driving.
ex.zh: 政府對酒駕的態度越來越強硬。

ex.en: My boss is tough but fair.
ex.zh: 我老闆很嚴格，但很公正。

tough.en: strict and firm, and showing no mercy

ex.en: This steak is too tough to chew.
ex.zh: 這塊牛排老到咬不動。

ex.en: The meat was dry and tough.
ex.zh: 這肉又乾又硬。

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來遊客人數大幅增加。

ex.en: The only people who do this are tourists.
ex.zh: 會這樣做的只有觀光客。

ex.en: The tourists were fascinated with the exquisite scenery.
ex.zh: 觀光客被絕美的景色深深吸引。

tourist.en: a person who travels to a place for pleasure

ex.en: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
ex.zh: 走遍所有觀光景點真的把我累壞了。

ex.en: Jiufen is a popular tourist spot near Taipei.
ex.zh: 九份是台北附近很受歡迎的觀光景點。

tourist.en: relating to people who travel for pleasure

ex.en: There was a sudden change in her tone.
ex.zh: 她的語氣突然變了。

ex.en: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?
ex.zh: 你有沒有聽出他說話的語氣怪怪的？

ex.en: She spoke in soft tones.
ex.zh: 她用輕柔的語調說話。

tone.en: the quality of a voice that shows what the speaker feels

ex.en: Chinese is a language that has four tones.
ex.zh: 中文是有四個聲調的語言。

ex.en: Tones can be hard for English speakers to learn.
ex.zh: 對說英語的人來說，聲調可能很難學。

tone.en: the rising or falling pitch of the voice that gives a word its meaning

ex.en: The CEO's speech set a positive tone for the meeting.
ex.zh: 執行長的演講為會議定下了正面的基調。

ex.en: The opening song set the tone for the evening.
ex.zh: 開場歌曲為整個晚上定下了基調。

tone.en: the general feeling or mood of a situation or piece of writing

ex.en: It was her little sister that broke her toy.
ex.zh: 弄壞她玩具的是她妹妹。

ex.en: The toy department is on the fifth floor.
ex.zh: 玩具部在五樓。

ex.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
ex.zh: 我想要一個盒子來收這些玩具。

toy.en: an object that children play with

toy.zh: toy with：把玩；隨便想想（某個主意）

ex.en: She toyed with the idea of moving abroad.
ex.zh: 她有想過要不要搬到國外。

ex.en: He was toying with his pen during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他開會時一直在把玩他的筆。

toy.en: to touch something absently, or to think about doing something without being serious

ex.en: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
ex.zh: 如果牙齒痛，就應該去看牙醫。

ex.en: She said that she brushes her teeth every morning.
ex.zh: 她說她每天早上都會刷牙。

ex.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
ex.zh: 他下巴骨折，還掉了幾顆牙。

tooth.en: one of the hard white parts in your mouth used for biting and chewing

ex.en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
ex.zh: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

ex.en: We saw the tower in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們遠遠就看到了那座塔。

ex.en: The school's tallest structure is that water tower.
ex.zh: 學校最高的建築就是那座水塔。

tower.en: a tall narrow building or part of a building

ex.en: New York bristles with towering buildings.
ex.zh: 紐約到處都是高聳的大樓。

ex.en: The new building towers over the old town.
ex.zh: 新大樓高聳在舊城區之上。

tower.en: to be much taller than the things around

ex.en: English is useful in diplomacy and tourism.
ex.zh: 英文在外交和觀光業很有用。

ex.en: Tourism generated many new jobs.
ex.zh: 觀光業創造了許多新的工作機會。

ex.en: Tourism is important to Taiwan's economy.
ex.zh: 觀光業對台灣經濟很重要。

tourism.en: the business of providing services for people who travel for pleasure

ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
ex.zh: 他拿起一面鏡子檢查自己的舌頭。

ex.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
ex.zh: 我被熱湯燙到舌頭。

tongue.en: the soft part inside your mouth that you use for tasting and speaking

ex.en: Translating helps us to know our mother tongue better.
ex.zh: 翻譯能幫助我們更了解自己的母語。

ex.en: English is not her native tongue.
ex.zh: 英文不是她的母語。

tongue.zh: on the tip of one's tongue：話到嘴邊（卻想不起來）

ex.en: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
ex.zh: 他的名字就在嘴邊，可是想不起來。

ex.en: The answer was on the tip of my tongue.
ex.zh: 答案就在嘴邊，卻說不出來。

tongue.en: about to be remembered or said but not quite remembered

ex.en: Some cleaning products are toxic.
ex.zh: 有些清潔用品有毒。

ex.en: The factory released toxic waste into the river.
ex.zh: 工廠把有毒廢棄物排進河裡。

toxic.en: containing poison that can harm or kill

toxic.zh: 有害的、惡質的（環境、關係）

ex.en: She quit because of the toxic work environment.
ex.zh: 她因為惡劣的工作環境而離職。

ex.en: It's important to stay away from toxic relationships.
ex.zh: 遠離有害的人際關係很重要。

toxic.en: very harmful and unpleasant to be in

ex.en: On leaving school, we presented him with a table clock as a token of our thanks.
ex.zh: 我們畢業時送他一個桌鐘，表示我們的謝意。

ex.en: Please accept this gift as a token of our appreciation.
ex.zh: 請收下這份禮物，聊表我們的謝意。

token.en: a thing given or kept as a sign of a feeling or fact

ex.en: You need a token to use the washing machine.
ex.zh: 使用洗衣機需要投代幣。

ex.en: Each player gets ten tokens at the start of the game.
ex.zh: 每位玩家在遊戲開始時拿到十個代幣。

token.en: a small disc or voucher that can be used instead of money for a particular service or shop

ex.en: The app sends a security token to your phone.
ex.zh: 這個 App 會傳送安全驗證碼到你的手機。

ex.en: The model can process thousands of tokens at once.
ex.zh: 這個模型可以一次處理數千個詞元。

token.en: a digital code that proves identity, or a small unit of text in a language program

ex.en: The company made only a token effort to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司只是做做樣子地處理這個問題。

ex.en: They charge a token fee for the workshop.
ex.zh: 他們對這場工作坊收取象徵性的費用。

token.en: done only to give an impression, and too small to have real effect

ex.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
ex.zh: 他在西洋棋錦標賽中奪得冠軍。

ex.en: That athlete won three times in a row in this tournament.
ex.zh: 那位選手在這項賽事中三連霸。

ex.en: We have to win seven times in a row to win this tournament.
ex.zh: 我們必須連勝七場才能贏得這次錦標賽。

tournament.en: a sports or game competition in which many players or teams play several rounds to find a winner

ex.en: It is said that Dutch are tolerant.
ex.zh: 人們常說荷蘭人很寬容。

ex.en: She is tolerant of other people's opinions.
ex.zh: 她能包容別人的意見。

tolerant.en: willing to accept different opinions or behavior without anger

ex.en: By reading books and discussing concepts, a person can gain wisdom and tolerance of differing ideas.
ex.zh: 透過讀書和討論觀念，人可以獲得智慧，並包容不同的想法。

ex.en: We should show tolerance toward other cultures.
ex.zh: 我們應該包容其他文化。

tolerance.en: willingness to accept people and ideas that are different from your own

ex.en: He has a low tolerance for pain.
ex.zh: 他很怕痛。

ex.en: Some people have a high tolerance for spicy food.
ex.zh: 有些人很能吃辣。

tolerance.en: the ability to bear pain, hardship or a drug without being badly affected

ex.en: The parts must be made to a tolerance of 0.1 mm.
ex.zh: 零件的公差必須在 0.1 公釐以內。

ex.en: This machine works within very tight tolerances.
ex.zh: 這台機器的容許誤差非常小。

tolerance.en: the small amount by which a measurement may differ from the exact size and still be acceptable

ex.en: The townhouse has a small courtyard and a private garage.
ex.zh: 這棟連棟住宅有小庭院和私人車庫。

ex.en: They chose a townhouse close to the commuter rail station.
ex.zh: 他們選了一間靠近通勤鐵路站的連棟住宅。

townhouse.en: a tall narrow house that is joined to other similar houses in a row

ex.en: The director raised a glass to toast the retiring team leader.
ex.zh: 主管舉杯祝賀即將退休的團隊負責人。

ex.en: Toast the bread lightly before adding the topping.
ex.zh: 先把麵包稍微烤過，再放上配料。

toast.en: to drink in honor of someone, or to cook bread until it is brown and crisp

ex.en: She wiped her wet hair with a towel.
ex.zh: 她用毛巾把濕頭髮擦乾。

ex.en: She came out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel.
ex.zh: 她圍著一條浴巾從浴室走了出來。

ex.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
ex.zh: 這條毛巾蓬鬆又柔軟，特別舒服。

towel.en: a piece of soft cloth used for drying the body or things that are wet

ex.en: Do you offer any all-day tours?
ex.zh: 你們有一日遊的行程嗎？

ex.en: How much is the tour per person?
ex.zh: 這個行程一個人多少錢？

tour.en: a trip to visit several places, or a walk around a place with a guide

ex.en: We toured all the major cities.
ex.zh: 我們遊覽了所有主要城市。

ex.en: The band will tour Asia next year.
ex.zh: 這個樂團明年將巡迴亞洲。

tour.en: to travel around a place or places for pleasure, or to travel to perform in different places

touristy.zh: 觀光客很多的、太觀光化的

ex.en: The old street is a bit touristy, but the food is good.
ex.zh: 老街有點太觀光化，但東西很好吃。

ex.en: We avoided the touristy areas and ate where the locals eat.
ex.zh: 我們避開觀光客多的地方，去當地人吃飯的地方。

touristy.en: full of visitors and made to attract them, often in a way that seems cheap or false

ex.en: Call our toll-free number for customer support.
ex.zh: 請撥打我們的免付費客服專線。

ex.en: The hotline is toll-free and open 24 hours.
ex.zh: 這條專線免付費，24 小時服務。

toll-free.en: describing a phone call that costs the caller nothing

ex.en: He tossed the ball to his little brother.
ex.zh: 他把球丟給他的弟弟。

ex.en: She tossed her bag onto the sofa and sat down.
ex.zh: 她把包包丟到沙發上然後坐了下來。

ex.en: Let's toss a coin to decide who goes first.
ex.zh: 我們來擲硬幣決定誰先開始。

ex.en: They tossed for the last seat on the bus.
ex.zh: 他們擲硬幣決定公車上最後一個座位歸誰。

ex.en: I tossed and turned all night because of the heat.
ex.zh: 我因為太熱，整晚翻來覆去睡不著。

ex.en: The small boat was tossed about by the waves.
ex.zh: 那艘小船被海浪搖晃得很厲害。

ex.en: I hurt my big toe when I kicked the table.
ex.zh: 我踢到桌子，弄傷了大腳趾。

ex.en: The baby wiggled her tiny toes.
ex.zh: 寶寶扭動著小小的腳趾。

ex.en: There is a hole in the toe of my sock.
ex.zh: 我襪子的腳尖破了個洞。

ex.en: These shoes have steel toes for safety.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋有鋼頭，以確保安全。

ex.en: Please remember to flush the toilet after you use it.
ex.zh: 使用完馬桶後請記得沖水。

ex.en: The toilet in this restaurant is clean and easy to find.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的廁所很乾淨，也很好找。

ex.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet on this floor?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問這一層的廁所在哪裡？

ex.en: The quarterback threw a long pass for a touchdown.
ex.zh: 四分衛長傳達陣得分。

ex.en: The crowd cheered loudly after the team's second touchdown.
ex.zh: 球隊第二次達陣後，觀眾大聲歡呼。

ex.en: The pilot made a smooth touchdown despite the strong wind.
ex.zh: 儘管風很大，機師還是平穩地著陸。

ex.en: Passengers clapped after the touchdown.
ex.zh: 飛機著陸後，乘客們鼓起掌來。

ex.en: The children ran towards the ice cream truck.
ex.zh: 孩子們朝著冰淇淋車跑去。

ex.en: She has a friendly attitude towards everyone.
ex.zh: 她對每個人的態度都很友善。

ex.en: We walked slowly towards the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我們慢慢地走向那座老橋。

ex.en: Tom is a short and common name in English.
ex.zh: 湯姆是英語中一個簡短又常見的名字。

ex.en: Tom brought his guitar to the party last night.
ex.zh: 湯姆昨晚把吉他帶到派對上。

ex.en: Our neighbor's tom wandered into the garden again.
ex.zh: 我們鄰居的公貓又晃進花園裡了。

ex.en: A tom turkey spreads its tail feathers to look bigger.
ex.zh: 雄火雞會張開尾羽讓自己看起來更大。

ex.en: Tony is a short form of the name Anthony.
ex.zh: 東尼是安東尼這個名字的簡稱。

ex.en: Tony runs a small bakery near the park.
ex.zh: 東尼在公園附近經營一家小麵包店。

ex.en: Tommy rides his bike to school every day.
ex.zh: 湯米每天騎腳踏車上學。

ex.en: Tommy shared his lunch with the new student.
ex.zh: 湯米把午餐分給新同學吃。

ex.en: The guide carried a burning torch into the cave.
ex.zh: 嚮導拿著燃燒的火把走進洞穴。

ex.en: Runners passed the Olympic torch from one to another.
ex.zh: 跑者們一個接一個地傳遞奧運聖火。

ex.en: I used a torch to find my keys in the dark.
ex.zh: 我用手電筒在黑暗中找我的鑰匙。

ex.en: Please bring a torch in case the power goes out.
ex.zh: 請帶一支手電筒，以防停電。

ex.en: Someone torched the old shed behind the farm.
ex.zh: 有人放火燒了農場後面的舊棚屋。

ex.en: The chef torched the sugar on top of the dessert.
ex.zh: 廚師用噴槍把甜點上的糖烤焦了。

ex.en: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
ex.zh: 東京是日本的首都。

ex.en: Millions of people take the train in Tokyo every day.
ex.zh: 東京每天有數百萬人搭乘電車。

ex.en: The toddler took his first steps across the living room.
ex.zh: 那個學步的幼兒走過客廳，邁出了第一步。

ex.en: Toddlers need a lot of sleep and a lot of attention.
ex.zh: 學步的幼兒需要充足的睡眠和許多關注。

ex.en: The ancient tomb was found deep under the sand.
ex.zh: 那座古墓被發現埋在深深的沙子底下。

ex.en: Tourists visit the tomb of the old king.
ex.zh: 遊客們前往參觀那位古代國王的陵墓。

ex.en: Flowers were placed on the tomb every spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，人們都會在墓前放上花。

ex.en: Street vendors tout their goods loudly to passing tourists.
ex.zh: 街頭小販對路過的遊客大聲兜售商品。

ex.en: Men outside the station tout cheap rooms to travelers.
ex.zh: 車站外的男子向旅客招攬便宜的房間。

ex.en: The company touts its new phone as the fastest on the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司大力宣傳新手機是市面上最快的。

ex.en: Many people tout this diet as a cure for everything.
ex.zh: 許多人吹捧這種飲食法是萬靈丹。

ex.en: A tornado destroyed several farms in the area.
ex.zh: 一場龍捲風摧毀了該地區的好幾座農場。

ex.en: Residents ran to the basement when the tornado warning sounded.
ex.zh: 龍捲風警報響起時，居民都跑進地下室。

ex.en: The doctor checked the burn on his torso.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查他軀幹上的燒傷。

ex.en: Swimming strengthens your arms, legs, and torso.
ex.zh: 游泳能強化手臂、雙腿和軀幹。

ex.en: The protesters wanted to topple the government.
ex.zh: 抗議者想要推翻政府。

ex.en: Rebels toppled the king after years of unrest.
ex.zh: 叛軍在多年動盪後推翻了國王。

ex.en: The tall stack of boxes toppled over.
ex.zh: 那疊高高的箱子倒了下來。

ex.en: The vase toppled off the shelf during the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震時花瓶從架子上摔了下來。

ex.en: He ordered a gin and tonic at the bar.
ex.zh: 他在酒吧點了一杯琴通寧。

ex.en: I like tonic with a slice of lemon.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在通寧水裡加一片檸檬。

ex.en: Grandma gave me a herbal tonic when I felt weak.
ex.zh: 我覺得虛弱時，奶奶給了我一帖草本補藥。

ex.en: The old doctor sold a tonic that was supposed to cure everything.
ex.zh: 那位老醫生賣一種號稱什麼病都能治的補藥。

ex.en: A walk in the fresh air was a real tonic after a long day.
ex.zh: 忙了一整天後，到戶外呼吸新鮮空氣真是提神醒腦。

ex.en: Her laughter was a tonic for everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 她的笑聲讓房間裡的每個人都精神一振。

ex.en: He wrapped the beans and cheese in a warm tortilla.
ex.zh: 他用溫熱的墨西哥薄餅包起豆子和起司。

ex.en: Fresh corn tortillas taste better than store-bought ones.
ex.zh: 新鮮的玉米餅比店裡買的好吃。

ex.en: This engine produces a lot of torque at low speeds.
ex.zh: 這具引擎在低速時能產生很大的扭力。

ex.en: Use a wrench to apply torque to the bolt.
ex.zh: 用扳手對螺栓施加扭力。

ex.en: Some mushrooms contain a toxin that can make you sick.
ex.zh: 有些菇類含有會讓人生病的毒素。

ex.en: The body removes most toxins through the liver.
ex.zh: 身體主要透過肝臟排除大部分毒素。

ex.en: Scientists found a toxin in the polluted river.
ex.zh: 科學家在受汙染的河裡發現一種毒素。

ex.en: The movie ended with a touching scene between a father and his son.
ex.zh: 電影以父子之間感人的一幕作結。

ex.en: It was touching to see strangers help the old man.
ex.zh: 看到陌生人幫助老先生，真令人感動。

ex.en: Please stop touching the paintings in the museum.
ex.zh: 請不要再碰博物館裡的畫作。

ex.en: The two wires are touching, which could cause a short circuit.
ex.zh: 這兩條電線碰在一起，可能會造成短路。

ex.en: The township has a small library and one school.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮有一間小圖書館和一所學校。

ex.en: She works at the township office downtown.
ex.zh: 她在市區的鎮公所工作。

ex.en: We looked up at the towering mountains.
ex.zh: 我們抬頭望著高聳的群山。

ex.en: A towering oak tree stood in the middle of the yard.
ex.zh: 一棵高聳的橡樹矗立在院子中央。

ex.en: She wore a ring with a golden topaz.
ex.zh: 她戴著一枚鑲有金黃色黃玉的戒指。

ex.en: Topaz is often used to make jewelry.
ex.zh: 黃玉常被用來製作珠寶。

ex.en: My jacket was torn when it caught on the fence.
ex.zh: 我的外套被圍籬勾到而撕破了。

ex.en: He has torn the letter into small pieces.
ex.zh: 他把那封信撕成了碎片。

ex.en: The page was torn out of the notebook.
ex.zh: 那一頁被從筆記本上撕了下來。

ex.en: I cooked tofu with garlic and green onions for dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐用大蒜和青蔥煮了豆腐。

ex.en: Tofu is a good source of protein for vegetarians.
ex.zh: 豆腐是素食者很好的蛋白質來源。

ex.en: Toronto is the largest city in Canada.
ex.zh: 多倫多是加拿大最大的城市。

ex.en: The CN Tower is a famous landmark in Toronto.
ex.zh: 加拿大國家電視塔是多倫多著名的地標。

ex.en: Touring the old town on foot takes about two hours.
ex.zh: 步行遊覽老城區大約要兩個小時。

ex.en: The band spent a year touring Europe.
ex.zh: 這個樂團花了一年在歐洲巡迴演出。

ex.en: The touring company will perform here next week.
ex.zh: 這個巡迴劇團下週將在這裡演出。

ex.en: We took a touring bus around the city.
ex.zh: 我們搭了一輛觀光巴士遊覽市區。

ex.en: A toad jumped out from under the wet leaves.
ex.zh: 一隻蟾蜍從潮濕的落葉下跳了出來。

ex.en: Toads have dry, bumpy skin unlike most frogs.
ex.zh: 蟾蜍有乾燥凹凸的皮膚，和大多數青蛙不同。

ex.en: What topping would you like on your pizza?
ex.zh: 你的披薩想加什麼配料？

ex.en: The cake has a thick chocolate topping.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕上有一層厚厚的巧克力淋面。

topping.zh: 超過、位於…之上（現在分詞）

ex.en: Temperatures are topping 35 degrees this week.
ex.zh: 本週氣溫超過三十五度。

ex.en: She finished the sundae by topping it with fresh strawberries.
ex.zh: 她在冰淇淋上放了新鮮草莓作為收尾。

ex.en: Rain poured down in a torrent all night.
ex.zh: 雨整晚像傾盆般落下。

ex.en: The river became a torrent after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，那條河變成了急流。

ex.en: She received a torrent of messages after the news.
ex.zh: 消息公布後，她收到了大量湧入的訊息。

ex.en: He answered with a torrent of angry words.
ex.zh: 他以連珠炮般的怒言回應。

ex.en: I like toasted bread with butter.
ex.zh: 我喜歡塗奶油的烤麵包。

ex.en: She added toasted nuts to the salad.
ex.zh: 她在沙拉裡加了烤過的堅果。

ex.en: We toasted the new couple with sparkling juice.
ex.zh: 我們用氣泡果汁向新人舉杯祝賀。

ex.en: He toasted his friend's success at the dinner.
ex.zh: 他在晚宴上舉杯慶祝朋友成功。

ex.en: The country was ruled by a totalitarian regime for decades.
ex.zh: 這個國家被極權政權統治了數十年。

ex.en: In a totalitarian state, the press is strictly controlled.
ex.zh: 在極權國家裡，媒體受到嚴格控制。

ex.en: The talk show covers topical issues every night.
ex.zh: 這個談話節目每晚討論當前的時事議題。

ex.en: His jokes were topical and made the audience laugh.
ex.zh: 他的笑話很貼近時事，逗得觀眾大笑。

ex.en: The totality of the evidence points to one answer.
ex.zh: 全部證據都指向同一個答案。

ex.en: You need to see the project in its totality, not only one part.
ex.zh: 你需要從整體來看這個專案，而不只是其中一部分。

ex.en: The long wait was pure torment for her.
ex.zh: 漫長的等待對她來說是純粹的折磨。

ex.en: He lived in torment after the mistake.
ex.zh: 犯錯之後，他活在痛苦之中。

ex.en: The noise from the street tormented him all night.
ex.zh: 街上的噪音整晚折磨著他。

ex.en: Memories of the accident still torment her.
ex.zh: 那場意外的記憶仍折磨著她。

ex.en: The tortoise moved slowly across the garden.
ex.zh: 那隻烏龜慢慢地爬過花園。

ex.en: Some tortoises can live for more than a hundred years.
ex.zh: 有些陸龜可以活超過一百年。

ex.en: The toughness of the material makes it ideal for work boots.
ex.zh: 這種材料的堅韌性很適合做工作靴。

ex.en: Her mental toughness helped her finish the marathon.
ex.zh: 她堅強的意志力幫助她跑完馬拉松。

ex.en: The toughness of the steak made it hard to chew.
ex.zh: 這塊牛排的肉質太硬，很難咬。

ex.en: Overcooking increases the toughness of the meat.
ex.zh: 煮過頭會讓肉變得更老。

ex.en: Scientists tested the toxicity of the chemical on fish.
ex.zh: 科學家測試了這種化學物質對魚類的毒性。

ex.en: The toxicity of some mushrooms can be deadly.
ex.zh: 有些蘑菇的毒性可能致命。

ex.en: Lead paint was banned because of its toxicity.
ex.zh: 含鉛油漆因其毒性而被禁用。

ex.en: The submarine carried several torpedoes on board.
ex.zh: 這艘潛艇上載有數枚魚雷。

ex.en: A torpedo is a kind of underwater weapon used by navies.
ex.zh: 魚雷是海軍使用的一種水下武器。

ex.en: One careless comment could torpedo the whole deal.
ex.zh: 一句不經意的話就可能把整筆交易搞砸。

ex.en: The sudden budget cut torpedoed their project.
ex.zh: 突然的預算刪減讓他們的專案泡湯了。

ex.en: After years of toil, the farmer finally bought his own land.
ex.zh: 辛勞多年後，那位農夫終於買下了自己的土地。

ex.en: The success of the team was the result of long hours of toil.
ex.zh: 這支團隊的成功來自長時間的辛勤付出。

ex.en: They toil in the fields from sunrise to sunset.
ex.zh: 他們從日出到日落都在田裡辛苦工作。

ex.en: My mother toiled for years to give us a better life.
ex.zh: 我媽媽辛苦工作多年，只為給我們更好的生活。

ex.en: The topography of the island is mostly hills and valleys.
ex.zh: 這座島的地形大多是丘陵和山谷。

ex.en: Engineers studied the topography before building the road.
ex.zh: 工程師在修路前先研究了地形。

ex.en: She had to tote heavy bags up four flights of stairs.
ex.zh: 她得把沉重的袋子扛上四層樓。

ex.en: Hikers tote their own water on this trail.
ex.zh: 健行者在這條步道上得自己帶水。

ex.en: I put my laptop in a canvas tote.
ex.zh: 我把筆電放進帆布托特包裡。

ex.en: She carries a tote to the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每個週六都提著托特包去市場。

ex.en: Tolkien wrote The Lord of the Rings.
ex.zh: 托爾金寫了《魔戒》。

ex.en: Many fantasy writers have been influenced by Tolkien.
ex.zh: 許多奇幻作家都受到托爾金的影響。

ex.en: The old tombstone was covered with moss.
ex.zh: 那塊老墓碑上長滿了青苔。

ex.en: His name was carved into a simple stone tombstone.
ex.zh: 他的名字被刻在一塊樸素的石頭墓碑上。

ex.en: He picked up a toothpick after finishing the meal.
ex.zh: 他吃完飯後拿了一根牙籤。

ex.en: Each small snack was held together with a toothpick.
ex.zh: 每一塊小點心都用一根牙籤固定著。

ex.en: The heat was tolerable once we sat in the shade.
ex.zh: 一坐到陰涼處，這種熱度就還能忍受。

ex.en: The food at the cafe was tolerable but nothing special.
ex.zh: 那間咖啡館的食物還過得去，但沒什麼特別。

ex.en: The townspeople gathered in the square to hear the news.
ex.zh: 鎮民們聚集在廣場上聽消息。

ex.en: Friendly townspeople helped us find the hotel.
ex.zh: 親切的鎮民幫我們找到了旅館。

ex.en: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush for the trip.
ex.zh: 別忘了把你的牙刷放進旅行行李。

ex.en: I need to replace my toothbrush every three months.
ex.zh: 我每三個月就要換一支牙刷。

ex.en: I ran out of toothpaste this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上牙膏用完了。

ex.en: Squeeze a small amount of toothpaste onto the brush.
ex.zh: 擠一點牙膏到牙刷上。

ex.en: Torrential rain flooded the streets in just an hour.
ex.zh: 傾盆大雨在短短一小時內淹沒了街道。

ex.en: The torrential river was too dangerous to cross.
ex.zh: 那條湍急的河太危險，無法渡過。

ex.en: The little tot ran across the yard in her red boots.
ex.zh: 那個小娃兒穿著紅靴子跑過院子。

ex.en: The park has a safe play area for tots.
ex.zh: 公園裡有一區供幼兒玩耍的安全遊戲區。

ex.en: Let me tot up the bill for the table.
ex.zh: 讓我把這桌的帳單加總一下。

ex.en: When you tot the numbers up, the total is much higher than expected.
ex.zh: 把數字加總後，總數比預期高出許多。

ex.en: Put two slices of bread in the toaster, please.
ex.zh: 請把兩片吐司放進烤麵包機。

ex.en: Our toaster burned the bread again this morning.
ex.zh: 我們的烤麵包機今早又把麵包烤焦了。

ex.en: He carried a heavy tome on the history of Rome.
ex.zh: 他拿著一本關於羅馬歷史的厚重大書。

ex.en: The library keeps an ancient tome in a glass case.
ex.zh: 圖書館把一本古老的巨冊收藏在玻璃櫃裡。

ex.en: He had a tortured look on his face after the bad news.
ex.zh: 聽到壞消息後，他臉上露出痛苦的神情。

ex.en: The poet wrote about a tortured soul searching for peace.
ex.zh: 那位詩人寫的是一個飽受煎熬、尋求平靜的靈魂。

ex.en: Chinese is a tonal language.
ex.zh: 中文是一種有聲調的語言。

ex.en: The painting has subtle tonal changes from light to dark.
ex.zh: 這幅畫有從亮到暗的細膩色調變化。

ex.en: Use the tongs to pick up the hot sausages.
ex.zh: 用夾子夾起熱騰騰的香腸。

ex.en: He placed another log on the fire with a pair of tongs.
ex.zh: 他用一把火鉗把另一根木柴放進火裡。

ex.en: He cut his toenails before putting on the sandals.
ex.zh: 他穿涼鞋前先剪了腳趾甲。

ex.en: A heavy box fell and hurt her toenail.
ex.zh: 一個重箱子掉下來，傷到了她的腳趾甲。

ex.en: Hard training will toughen your muscles.
ex.zh: 艱苦的訓練會讓你的肌肉更結實。

ex.en: Hardships helped toughen her for the challenges ahead.
ex.zh: 艱難的處境讓她變得更堅強，足以面對往後的挑戰。

ex.en: The government plans to toughen the rules on pollution.
ex.zh: 政府打算把汙染的規定訂得更嚴格。

ex.en: The school decided to toughen its attendance policy.
ex.zh: 學校決定把出席規定訂得更嚴格。

ex.en: The city's glass towers shine in the evening light.
ex.zh: 這座城市的玻璃大樓在夕陽下閃閃發光。

ex.en: Two old stone towers guard the entrance to the castle.
ex.zh: 兩座古老的石塔守衛著城堡的入口。

ex.en: She gave me a piece of toffee.
ex.zh: 她給了我一顆太妃糖。

ex.en: Sticky toffee pudding is a classic British dessert.
ex.zh: 黏黏的太妃糖布丁是經典的英國甜點。

ex.en: The toddler began to totter across the room.
ex.zh: 那個幼兒開始搖搖晃晃地走過房間。

ex.en: The old man tottered along the street with his cane.
ex.zh: 老先生拄著拐杖，步履蹣跚地走在街上。

ex.en: We climbed to the top of the tor to see the view.
ex.zh: 我們爬上石山頂欣賞風景。

ex.en: A rocky tor stood above the moor.
ex.zh: 一座岩石山丘矗立在荒原之上。

ex.en: He gets touchy when people mention his weight.
ex.zh: 別人一提到他的體重，他就變得很敏感易怒。

ex.en: My sister is a little touchy this morning, so be nice.
ex.zh: 我姊姊今天早上有點易怒，你客氣一點。

ex.en: Money is a touchy subject in many families.
ex.zh: 金錢在許多家庭中都是敏感的話題。

ex.en: Let's avoid touchy topics like politics at dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐時我們就避開政治這類敏感話題吧。

ex.en: The tribe carved a totem from a tall tree.
ex.zh: 部落用一棵高大的樹雕刻了一根圖騰柱。

ex.en: For them, the eagle is a sacred totem.
ex.zh: 對他們來說，老鷹是神聖的圖騰。

ex.en: The novel warns readers about the dangers of totalitarianism.
ex.zh: 這本小說警告讀者極權主義的危險。

ex.en: Under totalitarianism, the state tries to control every part of life.
ex.zh: 在極權主義下，國家試圖控制生活的每個層面。

ex.en: Farmers worry that heavy rain will wash away the topsoil.
ex.zh: 農夫擔心大雨會沖走表土。

ex.en: We spread fresh topsoil over the garden bed.
ex.zh: 我們在花圃上鋪了新的表土。

ex.en: Leo Tolstoy was a Russian writer who wrote War and Peace.
ex.zh: 列夫·托爾斯泰是俄國作家，寫了《戰爭與和平》。

ex.en: Our book club is reading a novel by Tolstoy.
ex.zh: 我們的讀書會正在讀一本托爾斯泰的小說。

ex.en: Toulouse is a large city in southern France.
ex.zh: 圖盧茲是法國南部的一座大城市。

ex.en: Many aircraft are built in Toulouse.
ex.zh: 許多飛機是在圖盧茲製造的。

ex.en: We walked along the towpath beside the canal.
ex.zh: 我們沿著運河邊的縴道散步。

ex.en: Cyclists enjoy the quiet towpath on weekends.
ex.zh: 週末時，騎自行車的人喜歡這條安靜的縴道。

ex.en: My uncle has been a Tory all his life.
ex.zh: 我叔叔一輩子都是保守黨員。

ex.en: The Tory candidate spoke at the town hall.
ex.zh: 保守黨候選人在市政廳發表了演說。

ex.en: He keeps a hammer and screwdrivers in the toolbox.
ex.zh: 他把鐵鎚和螺絲起子放在工具箱裡。

ex.en: Please put the toolbox back in the garage.
ex.zh: 請把工具箱放回車庫。

touche.zh: 說得好！（承認對方駁得有理）

ex.en: "You're not exactly on time either." "Touche!"
ex.zh: 「你自己也不是很準時啊。」「說得好！」

ex.en: Touche, I can't argue with that point.
ex.zh: 你說得對，這一點我沒法反駁。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is the touchstone of a good business.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意度是衡量好生意的標準。

ex.en: This exam is the touchstone by which students are judged.
ex.zh: 這場考試是評斷學生的檢驗標準。

ex.en: Doctors used tomography to look inside his chest.
ex.zh: 醫師用斷層掃描檢查他的胸腔內部。

ex.en: Computed tomography creates detailed images of the body.
ex.zh: 電腦斷層掃描能產生人體的詳細影像。

ex.en: We drove along a narrow, tortuous mountain road.
ex.zh: 我們沿著狹窄蜿蜒的山路開車。

ex.en: The tortuous process took months to complete.
ex.zh: 這個迂迴曲折的過程花了好幾個月才完成。

ex.en: The baby gave us a toothless smile.
ex.zh: 寶寶對我們露出了沒牙的笑容。

ex.en: The old dog was toothless but still happy.
ex.zh: 那隻老狗牙齒掉光了，但仍然很開心。

ex.en: She is studying toxicology at the university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修毒理學。

ex.en: A toxicology report showed what was in his blood.
ex.zh: 毒理學報告顯示了他血液中的成分。

ex.en: The school has no toleration of bullying.
ex.zh: 學校對霸凌零容忍。

ex.en: A society grows stronger through toleration of different views.
ex.zh: 社會因容忍不同觀點而更強大。

ex.en: The holiday dinner gave the whole family a sense of togetherness.
ex.zh: 這頓節日晚餐讓全家人有了親密相聚的感覺。

ex.en: Teamwork and togetherness helped us finish the project on time.
ex.zh: 團隊合作與團結一心讓我們如期完成了專案。

ex.en: We bought a topographic map before the hiking trip.
ex.zh: 我們在健行前買了一張地形圖。

ex.en: The topographic features of the valley make it hard to build roads.
ex.zh: 山谷的地形特徵讓修路變得困難。

ex.en: He was tormented by guilt for years.
ex.zh: 他多年來飽受罪惡感的折磨。

ex.en: The tormented look on her face worried us.
ex.zh: 她臉上痛苦的神情讓我們擔心。

ex.en: To date, the museum has had a million visitors.
ex.zh: 到目前為止，這間博物館已有一百萬名參觀者。

ex.en: This is his best work to date.
ex.zh: 這是他迄今最好的作品。

ex.en: To be honest, I didn't like the movie.
ex.zh: 老實說，我不喜歡那部電影。

ex.en: To be honest, I forgot your birthday.
ex.zh: 老實說，我忘了你的生日。

to be honest.en: used when saying what you really think

ex.en: To some extent, the team's success depends on luck.
ex.zh: 在某種程度上，這支球隊的成功要靠運氣。

ex.en: I agree with you to some extent, but I have a few doubts.
ex.zh: 我在某種程度上同意你，但還有一些疑慮。

ex.en: To sum up, the plan is cheap, simple, and safe.
ex.zh: 總之，這個計畫便宜、簡單又安全。

ex.en: To sum up, we need more time and more people.
ex.zh: 總而言之，我們需要更多時間和人手。

to sum up.en: used before a short summary of what was said

ex.en: Her email was short and to the point.
ex.zh: 她的電子郵件簡短又切中重點。

ex.en: Please keep your speech to the point so we can finish on time.
ex.zh: 請讓你的演講簡潔扼要，我們才能準時結束。

to the point.en: clear and short, without extra words

ex.en: It was touch and go for a while, but the patient recovered.
ex.zh: 一度情況很危急，但病人康復了。

ex.en: The game was touch and go until the last minute.
ex.zh: 比賽直到最後一刻都勝負難料。

touch and go.en: uncertain, with a risk that things may go wrong

ex.en: He wrote the review tongue in cheek, so don't take it seriously.
ex.zh: 他是半開玩笑地寫這篇評論，所以別當真。

ex.en: Her speech was funny and clearly tongue in cheek.
ex.zh: 她的演講很有趣，顯然是開玩笑的。

tongue in cheek.en: said as a joke, not seriously

ex.en: To begin with, we need a bigger table.
ex.zh: 首先，我們需要一張更大的桌子。

ex.en: There are many reasons. To begin with, it costs too much.
ex.zh: 原因有很多。第一，它太貴了。

to begin with.en: used to introduce the first point

ex.en: To begin with, I didn't like my new job.
ex.zh: 起初我並不喜歡我的新工作。

ex.en: The plan seemed simple to begin with.
ex.zh: 這個計畫一開始看起來很簡單。

to begin with.en: at the start of a situation
